W7_kalkan.label: W7 · Kalkan
W7_kalkan.blurb: Yedek yer hizmetleri + partner + ücretsiz değişiklik, grevden 1 hafta önce

decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights to or from Orlando or Philadelphia between December 21 and December 27

actions.action: Backup ground handling contract at both bases for the strike days
Rebooking deal with a partner airline for 2 disrupted weeks
Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window

decisions.message: Kestrel Air update: workers at our ground handling contractor in Orlando and Philadelphia plan a 48-hour strike on Dec 22-23. We have hired a backup ground handling team for both airports, but some flights may still be late or canceled. If you are booked between Dec 14 and Dec 27, you can change or cancel for free in the app now. If your flight is canceled, we will rebook you on Kestrel or a partner airline, or give you a full refund if you prefer. We will text you first if anything changes.
decisions.why:
Own seats in week 8 are 97% booked, so most strike-day passengers can only be protected by moving early or by a partner airline.
The backup contract lowers cancellations on the days that count for goal 2 and insures against an extension that would count for goal 1.
Telling people a week ahead, honestly, is what the CEO says passengers remember.

W7_yalin.blurb: Partner + ücretsiz değişiklik, yedek sözleşme yok

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: a 48-hour ground handling strike is planned at Orlando and Philadelphia on Dec 22-23, and flights on those days may be late or canceled. If you can travel on another day, move your flight now for free in the app: Dec 21 and Dec 24 still have seats. If you keep your flight and it is canceled, we will rebook you on Kestrel or a partner airline, or refund you in full if you prefer.
decisions.why:
Own seats in week 8 are 97% booked, so moving people early and a partner airline are the cheapest protection.
We skip the backup contract and keep $2.5M in reserve for surprises.
An honest early warning is what passengers remember.

W8_grev_gunu.label: W8 · Grev günü bakım
W8_grev_gunu.blurb: Otel + ek personel + $75 kredi, grev günü yolcularına

decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights at Orlando or Philadelphia on December 22 or 23

actions.action: Hotel rooms held for stranded passengers, whatever the cause
Extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks
Goodwill for affected passengers, up to 10,000 passengers

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: if the Dec 22-23 strike strands you overnight, hotel rooms are held for you, whatever the cause. Extra staff are at our Orlando and Philadelphia airports and on our phone lines. If your flight is canceled or more than 3 hours late, you will also get a $75 Kestrel travel credit.
decisions.why:
The strike days are where complaints and NPS are made.
Hotels and staff on the day stop a delay from becoming a stranding story.
The credit is cheap and mostly used on seats that would fly empty.

actions.action: Goodwill for affected passengers, up to 10,000 passengers
Extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks
Double loyalty points for affected passengers

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: we are sorry the Dec 22-23 strike disrupted your holiday trip. We have added a $75 Kestrel travel credit and double Kestrel Club points for that trip to your account. Extra staff are at our Orlando and Philadelphia airports and on our phone lines through January 10. If you are owed a refund, it is being paid automatically to your original payment method.

Complaints and NPS are judged against last winter, and the disrupted passengers are where both are made or lost.
A travel credit costs less than cash and is mostly used on seats that would fly empty.
Extra staff shorten the wait when people call back after the holidays.

talk.t: School is out and we are almost at the finish line. Still nothing official from Kestrel about Philly yet, so we just hold tight and see what happens this weekend.
talk.feel: Getting a little antsy since we're down to just a few days before departure and there's still no official word from Kestrel about the Philly strike, but I'm holding off on panicking until we actually

talk.t: We made it to Philly safely and the flight was on time, but I am just so nervous about the trip back on the 28th with Mom after everything I'm seeing online.
talk.feel: I am so relieved we made it up here for Christmas, but my stomach is still in knots thinking about flying back with Mom on the 28th.

talk.t: Rafael says everything is still on schedule for our flight on the 23rd, so we just need to keep holding tight and get the bags ready.
talk.feel: A little anxious with everyone talking about it, but Rafael's been taking care of our family trips for ten years so I trust him when he says to wait.

talk.t: Who, by name, will be with my son? Kestrel won't answer a single direct question about the strike and the unaccompanied minor escorts, and I am sick of the runaround.
talk.feel: Furious and terrified. They are playing chicken with an eleven-year-old child's safety and I am at my absolute breaking point.

talk.t: Look, those guys gotta eat too. Management just needs to cut a fair deal and stop messing around.
talk.feel: Hope management stops messing around and signs a fair contract with the boys.

talk.t: Look, negotiations take time, but Kestrel always does right by us folks flying out of Philly.
talk.feel: I am still standing by Kestrel; folks down at the shop like to talk big, but I've known those gate agents by name for years and they'll get it sorted.

talk.t: I am literally so happy to be home in Orlando, my flight was totally fine!
talk.feel: I am so relieved to finally be home in Orlando for winter break and literally not have to worry about my flight anymore.

talk.t: ratio + you owe me a flight fix this strike before my interview or I'm done with you forever
talk.feel: Stressed out and furious because my interview is right after I land and Kestrel still won't say a word.

talk.t: Hola Mamá, my exams are finally done and I am just packing my bag now, I am praying everything is okay with the flight next week.
talk.feel: I am feeling really nervous and stressed because my dorm closes this week and I have to go stay with my friend until the flight, and everyone keeps talking about the strike.

talk.t: Made it down to Tampa, flight was totally fine.
talk.feel: Glad to be home for winter break, though still think my dad should just use Delta next time.

talk.t: Grandma, stop worrying, my app literally says my flight on the 22nd is totally fine, I'll be home soon.
talk.feel: So stressed out because Grandma is worrying herself sick over the money and I just want to get home to her.

talk.t: Radio silence during a potential strike is no way to run an airline. Trying to figure out if I need to move our corporate account to American out of Harrisburg.
talk.feel: Annoyed by the lack of communication. If they can't handle basic updates, I'm not risking my Florida branch travel.

talk.t: Is anyone actually getting straight answers from Kestrel about the MCO ground situation for the holidays or are we all just refreshing the app into a void?
talk.feel: I am deeply stressed and frustrated. My Punta Cana trip is coming up right after Christmas and the complete radio silence from Kestrel is making me regret trusting them with my own travel.

talk.t: Kestrel you are actually useless, ghosting us while the 22nd is completely up in the air and my lighting case is on the line.
talk.feel: Completely panicked and furious because my lighting case is going to get wrecked or left behind right before the biggest wedding of my career.

talk.t: Mi gente, I am on the phone with Kestrel right now trying to get a straight answer on this MCO ground strike before our groups fly next week.
talk.feel: Stressed out and completely exhausted from trying to reassure forty families while the airline stays silent.

talk.t: Okay team parents, the strike talk is everywhere right now, but our flights are still a couple weeks out and Kestrel hasn't changed anything on our group booking yet, so let's just breathe and I'll let you know the second I hear anything official.
talk.feel: Exhausted and stretched thin. Everyone keeps forwarding me every little strike rumor they see online like I control the airlines.

talk.t: Twelve guests. Ceremony on the 30th. I'm done waiting on hold for people who won't give straight answers, so I am moving my PHL block to American right now at any price and sending every future wedding away from Kestrel.
talk.feel: Stressed, furious, and completely done relying on an airline that ghosts travel agents when their clients' destination weddings are on the line.

talk.t: In thirty years I've seen this movie before, and low-cost carriers always fail when it counts.
talk.feel: Vindicated in my decision to sever ties, but deeply irritated that the airline industry has come to this level of unprofessionalism.

talk.t: Okay everyone, I checked the Kestrel app again this morning and our flights on the 22nd still show as scheduled, but I am not loving this radio silence with the strike looming. I am keeping a very close eye on it and I swear I will let you all know the second I hear a single peep from them. Hang in there! Love, Keisha
talk.feel: Completely stressed out and furious at Kestrel for leaving us hanging while twenty-six family members panic in my ear.

talk.t: I cannot even believe this is happening after planning since June with my color-coded spreadsheet. Kestrel just canceled our PHL to MCO flight for the 22nd due to the strike and offered us a rebooked flight three days later, which completely wrecks our nonrefundable Disney resort and park tickets starting the 23rd. We
talk.feel: I am completely devastated and furious that our months of careful planning in my color-coded spreadsheet are ruined because Kestrel let this strike happen right before Christmas.

talk.t: Seriously, if MCO completely implodes by the 29th I am going to lose my mind. Keeping all my fingers crossed it holds together.
talk.feel: Super stressed and annoyed, just praying our flight on the 29th actually happens so I don't lose my money.

talk.t: We landed safely in Orlando and made it onto the cruise line bus. Let's keep our paperwork organized for the return flight next week just in case things get messy.
talk.feel: Relieved that the flight actually operated on schedule, but still keeping all our documentation ready for the return leg on the 28th given the ongoing labor issues.

talk.t: We actually made it! The flight was totally fine and now we are finally on resort time, I can't even believe it.
talk.feel: So relieved and exhausted after the flight, just trying to finally relax on the beach with my husband and put all the airplane anxiety behind us.

talk.t: Absolute dumpster fire. Glad we knocked out our Universal trip in November and didn't touch this mess.
talk.feel: Smug and relieved. So glad our Thanksgiving trip got in and out before this absolute circus.

talk.t: Dios mío, are we sure the airport in Orlando will be okay for our trip in January with all this strike talk? Elena says not to worry, so I am leaving it in God's hands.
talk.feel: I am getting a little nervous seeing all these messages about strikes right before Christmas, but Elena tells me not to worry so I am just praying it all works out for us in January.

talk.t: lol my kestrel flight to san juan just got canceled for the holidays, cool cool cool
talk.feel: so annoyed since i just wanted to get to the beach, but whatever, my dates are flexible so i'll just deal with it

talk.t: Ay, thank God we finally landed in San Juan, but our flight was three hours late and now the bags with all the kids' gifts are missing! We are waiting by baggage claim and I am praying they turn up soon because I don't know what I'm going to do.
talk.feel: Exhausted and so stressed out. I was terrified we were going to be stuck at the airport and ruin Christmas, and then losing the bags on top of it was just too much. I'm glad we're finally at Mamá's ho

talk.t: Well, whatever you think is best, Mary. I'm just sitting tight here until you get down.
talk.feel: I feel a bit bad that Mary has to drive all that way on account of the airport trouble, but she says not to worry about it.

talk.t: Our flight got canceled because of the strike. We can't wait three days for the next Kestrel flight or I'll miss my shift and we'll miss Christmas. I'm taking the refund and booking us on American out of Charlotte right now.
talk.feel: Panicked and furious. My return is non-negotiable because of my December 27th ICU shift, and now the whole holiday plan with the baby and in-laws is falling apart.

talk.feel: It was annoying standing around the gate for three hours with three kids, but at least we made it and Kestrel actually covered the delay with a credit.

talk.t: I am getting so nervous seeing all these strike posts on Facebook for next week, I really hope we can get Mom home without too much trouble.
talk.feel: I am so anxious about Mom flying back with me on the 28th, I just want to make sure she is okay and we do not get stuck in long lines.

talk.t: Thank God we made it down without any trouble! The kids are already eating with Mamá and Papá.
talk.feel: Relieved and happy to finally be here with the grandparents, even with all the worry about the strike.

talk.t: Who, by name, will be with my son now that Kestrel canceled our flight and threw our custody schedule into total chaos?

talk.t: Look, we made it down without a hitch, but those ground crews still deserve a square deal before we head back.
talk.feel: Glad we got down here to see the boy without any headaches, but I'm still keeping an eye on things for the way back.

talk.t: Let me tell you, I've been flying Kestrel since their second year and I know the folks working those gates at PHL. They'll sort it out before we head down to Atlanta next week.

talk.feel: Furious and stressed because my interview is on the 28th and waiting three days for another Kestrel flight is completely useless to me.

talk.t: My flight was three hours late and my bag is missing, but I am finally here in Merida with you all.
talk.feel: I was really stressed sitting at the gate waiting so long, and I was so worried about my bag being lost, but I am just so thankful I finally made it home to my parents.

talk.t: Grandma, don't worry, my flight got canceled from the strike so I'm trying to figure it out now, maybe I can just take the bus or something so you don't have to stress.
talk.feel: I feel so stressed and awful for Grandma since she paid for half of this ticket and was so worried all week, and now we have to figure out a whole new way home.

talk.t: What's it going to cost us in delays if these ground handling talks fall through before the new year?
talk.feel: Annoyed by the constant noise. If they can't get their act together by the first week of January, I'm pulling all 14 employees' travel over to American out of Harrisburg.

talk.t: My flight made it out on time thank God, but I am living on edge until this entire wedding party lands in Punta Cana.
talk.feel: Relieved that my own flight got out without a hitch, but completely stressed out and exhausted from managing all the last-minute coordinator panic while heading down to Punta Cana.

talk.t: Radio silence from Kestrel is completely unacceptable during a potential strike. Pushing travel management to drop them for American.
talk.feel: Fed up. Waiting to see if the team policy gets overridden before January.

talk.feel: I am completely losing my mind because my $6,500 wedding contract is on the line and Kestrel expects me to just miss the entire shoot.

talk.t: Still crickets from Kestrel on the PHL strike. If this is how they treat group partners during a crisis, I need everything in writing for my clients because I am done with them after this season.
talk.feel: Exhausted and thoroughly fed up with their complete disregard for agency partners. My mind is already made up about next year.

talk.t: My PHL group finally landed in Punta Cana, thank God, but the wheelchair assistance took over an hour. At least they made it before the ceremony.
talk.feel: Relieved that the first group finally made it despite the airport nightmare, but still furious about Kestrel's handling and the stress they put my clients through right before Christmas.

talk.t: In thirty years in this business, I have never seen such a glaring abdication of basic carrier responsibility.
talk.feel: Vindicated in my decision to sever ties with them. They simply do not have the operational maturity to handle holiday travel.

talk.t: Okay family, take a deep breath. Our flight today got canceled because of the strike, but I am on the phone with Kestrel right now and they are getting us sorted onto the next available flights and covering our hotels if we stay overnight. I will update everyone as soon as I have each family's new boarding passes. Love

talk.t: We made it back home! Our flight was right on time and everything went so smoothly, I can finally breathe again.
talk.feel: So relieved and happy that our honeymoon trip is ending smoothly and safely without any flight drama.

talk.t: Man, seeing all these poor bastards getting their custody weekends totally torched by Kestrel. Glad we got our Orlando run in early.
talk.feel: Smug and relieved we dodged that bullet in November, but furious on behalf of parents getting screwed over by this garbage airline.

talk.t: Ay Dios mío, with all these news stories I just pray our bags make it and we get to Montego Bay without any trouble. Let me know when you guys are packed!
talk.feel: A little bit nervous with all the news about delays, but Elena says everything is fine so I am keeping my faith.

talk.feel: relieved to have my money back, though still kinda annoyed the trip got nuked before it even started, but free money is free money

talk.t: Thank God we landed safely back in Philly and everything went smooth on the way home. Un abrazo a todos!
talk.feel: I am just so relieved we are home and back to normal, even though I have to go back to work tomorrow and my feet are killing me.

talk.t: Babe, Kestrel actually sent an email about a seventy-five dollar credit for the canceled flight. What a joke, considering American cost us a fortune.
talk.feel: Exhausted and completely over it. We survived the holiday trip by switching airlines, but seeing that paltry $75 credit message pop up just reminds me of how badly they messed up our Christmas and my

talk.t: Got that credit from Kestrel for the delay on the way up, not a bad deal.
talk.feel: Relieved the whole holiday trip is behind us and we made it back fine on the 27th.

talk.t: We made it back home to Ocala safely and Mom is resting in her own room now, thank the Lord.
talk.feel: I am just so relieved that Mom is finally back home in Ocala and resting comfortably after all my worrying.

talk.t: We just landed back in Orlando and everything went smooth. Time to unpack and get back to work tomorrow!
talk.feel: Relieved and happy to be back home with the kids and ready to get back to work on the pool route after a great Christmas with the grandparents.

talk.t: Well Leo is officially back home and the return flight was fine, but Kestrel is still never getting another dime from me after what they pulled.
talk.feel: Relieved that the trip is finally over and Leo is safely home with me, but still furious about the absolute nightmare Kestrel put us through earlier.

talk.t: Let me tell you, people were talking all kinds of nonsense about these Kestrel flights, but me and the missus flew down on the 30th smooth as silk, right on time.
talk.feel: I'm feeling mighty relieved and validated after all that barbershop chatter, because Kestrel got us down to see the grandkids right on time.

talk.t: Cool, a $75 credit after you completely torpedoed my interview trip and left me stranded. Ratio + you still owe me for ruining my break.
talk.feel: Furious and totally burned, because a measly $75 credit doesn't make up for losing a job interview and getting stranded over the holidays.

talk.t: Thank God I am finally home with you all, I am so glad the worst part is over.
talk.feel: I feel so relieved to finally be home in Mexico with my parents after all the stress with the strike in Philadelphia.

talk.feel: Annoyed by the lack of direct communication from Kestrel. I need hard numbers and reliability before I commit employee travel for the Florida branch.

talk.t: We made it back to Orlando and everyone survived, but I need a solid week of sleep before I even look at another flight schedule.
talk.feel: Exhausted and relieved that the wedding and all the travel are finally over, though my nerves are completely fried.

talk.t: Made it to PHL on my Kestrel flight without any issues at all. Guess I got lucky, but my plane was right on time.
talk.feel: Relieved and glad I didn't let all the internet panic make me change my plans.

talk.feel: Still furious because seventy-five dollars doesn't even begin to cover the markup I had to pay out of pocket just to get to my shoot.

talk.t: I need it in writing for my clients.
talk.feel: Extremely anxious and deeply frustrated with Kestrel's complete disregard for agency partners and senior groups.

talk.t: Okay team parents, flight home was totally on time and everyone is safely back in DE. Thanks for a great tournament!

talk.t: In thirty years I've seen this movie before, and cutting ties with Kestrel was the only prudent choice for any agency that values its reputation.
talk.feel: Vindicated. In thirty years I've seen this movie before, and Kestrel proved right before the New Year why cheap carriers always fail when it counts.

talk.feel: I feel so relieved that the whole family reunion trip is finally over and everyone is back home without any more airport nightmares.

talk.t: Kestrel just dropped a seventy-five dollar credit into our account like that makes up for completely ruining our Christmas Disney trip and our nonrefundable park tickets. What an absolute insult after everything they put us through last month.
talk.feel: Insulted and disgusted that they think a tiny little voucher fixes our ruined Disney vacation and all those lost park tickets.

talk.t: Flight was right on time, not a hitch.

talk.t: Thank God we got that seventy-five dollar credit from Kestrel in the app for the delayed flight down, at least they didn't leave us with nothing.
talk.feel: I am just so relieved that Christmas in Bayamon happened and we are back home safe in Philly, even if the flight down was stressful with the delay.

talk.t: Kestrel actually sent an email about a seventy-five dollar credit for the canceled flight. What a joke, considering American cost us a fortune.
talk.feel: I am still furious about how they handled the unaccompanied minor situation, and a measly seventy-five dollars doesn't even begin to cover what we had to pay to get Leo home on another airline.

talk.feel: Still annoyed they ruined my original plans and the interview, but at least getting some cash back takes a tiny bit of the sting away.

talk.t: I am back in my room now, thank you for everything, I love you guys so much.

talk.t: Seventy-five dollars doesn't fix a ruined holiday for forty families. I've already shifted my agency bookings elsewhere.
talk.feel: I feel done with them. A little credit doesn't bring back the Christmas I spent on the phone moving forty families.

talk.t: Kestrel sending out seventy-five dollar credits now like it makes up for nearly causing me to breach a six thousand dollar wedding contract. Unreal.
talk.feel: Exhausted and entirely unimpressed. A tiny credit doesn't erase the nightmare they put my PHL wedding group through.

talk.feel: I am so worried about getting Mom through the crowds and the wheelchair situation with all this strike mess.

talk.t: Rafael says he's locking in JetBlue just in case so we don't get stuck, so we're just waiting to see what he does.
talk.feel: A little nervous with the clock ticking down, but thankful Rafael is on top of it.

talk.t: Hey @KestrelAir how many times do I have to ask before someone gives me a straight answer? Who, by name, will be escorting my eleven-year-old son on the December 22nd flight out of Orlando during this strike?
talk.feel: Furious and terrified. My son's safety is completely on the line and these useless representatives keep reading from the same evasive script.

talk.t: Look, those guys gotta eat too. If management treats them right, nobody's striking on Christmas Eve.
talk.feel: Just waiting it out. Those guys at the union hall deserve a fair shake, but I got my fingers crossed it doesn't mess up our Christmas down in Orlando.

talk.t: Let me tell you, I've been flying Kestrel since their second year and I know the folks working those gates by name; they'll get us down to Atlanta to see the grandkids just fine once management sits down and does right by them.
talk.feel: I'm staying steady. You know, back when I drove for SEPTA, you learned that folks just need to talk things out and find a fair middle ground, but Kestrel's always taken care of me and my missus.

talk.t: Omg you guys I literally only have two finals left and then I am officially free and heading straight to Orlando!
talk.feel: I am literally so excited for finals to end and for winter break, and I'm not worried about the strike at all since my flight is next week.

talk.t: Kestrel Air is a joke, still radio silence on the Dec 22 strike while people's holiday plans are melting down. Answer us.
talk.feel: Stressed out and furious that Kestrel is completely ghosting its customers while my interview and flight hang by a thread.

talk.t: Hi Mama, I am just finishing up my packing and hoping the strike news doesn't affect my flight on the 23rd. I am praying everything goes okay.
talk.feel: I am getting pretty nervous seeing all these strike warnings since my flight is coming up soon and I don't know what I would do if I get stuck.

talk.t: Seriously dad, just book me Delta already before everything sells out.
talk.feel: Annoyed that my dad still hasn't switched me to Delta.

talk.t: Don't worry, Nana, I checked the app again and my flight to Baltimore is still on time for the 22nd.
talk.feel: Stressed because Nana keeps worrying herself sick over these stupid strike rumors, but I keep telling her my app says everything is normal.

talk.t: Do we have numbers on the proportion of ground handling staff actually participating in the PHL strike vote, or is this mostly social media amplification?
talk.feel: I feel slightly concerned for other travelers given the strike warnings, but since I am not flying this week, it doesn't directly impact my schedule.

talk.t: If Kestrel doesn't get this ground crew mess sorted out by next week, I'm shifting all the Florida branch travel over to American out of Harrisburg and dropping my Silver status.
talk.feel: Impatient and annoyed that Kestrel management is letting this drag out. It is getting close to decision time for the Florida branch travel.

talk.t: I am so over Kestrel ghosting everyone while we have six-figure weddings riding on their ground crew showing up.
talk.feel: Stressed and annoyed. It is completely unprofessional of them to leave planners and clients hanging like this.

talk.t: PHL flights went fine this week, but this strike cloud is still there. We need to lock in that American exception before January.
talk.feel: Annoyed. The flights worked, but the looming strike is ridiculous and management is doing nothing.

talk.t: Hey @KestrelAir are you just pretending the MCO ground crew strike on the 22nd isn't happening or what? Some of us actually have a $6,500 wedding contract to get to.
talk.feel: Completely on edge and furious that Kestrel is pretending everything is fine while my $6,500 contract hangs by a thread.

talk.t: If anyone is still waiting for Kestrel's group desk to call back about Philadelphia, don't hold your breath. I moved my January group to American last week and I'm sleeping much better for it.
talk.feel: Vindicated that I pulled the senior group last week, and deeply frustrated for my colleagues who are still stuck waiting on Kestrel to do their jobs.

talk.t: Mi gente, don't worry about the strike news, I already got all our seats secured on JetBlue weeks ago so nobody is getting stranded.
talk.feel: Relieved I made the call to switch my people, but stressed watching other agencies panic over the same old Kestrel mess.

talk.t: Okay team parents, I know everyone is exhausted seeing these strike headlines again, but our flights aren't until the end of the month and Kestrel still shows our group booking as normal so let's just breathe.
talk.feel: Exhausted and worn thin, just constantly having to play referee and calm everyone down when we can't actually do anything yet.

talk.t: I am losing my mind over this silence. Twelve guests out of Philly and still zero word from Kestrel on the strike. How are we supposed to plan?
talk.feel: Incredibly frustrated and anxious since my reputation and a $6,000 wedding gig are on the line.

talk.t: In thirty years I've seen this movie before, and Kestrel is playing right to type.
talk.feel: Completely vindicated in my decision to abandon this airline, and disgusted by their continued refusal to communicate with their agency partners.

talk.t: Morning family, I know everyone is getting antsy seeing all the strike posts online, but I just checked the host forum and our Kestrel bookings are still holding firm for the 22nd so let's try to stay calm. Love, Keisha (your travel agent)
talk.feel: I am getting so stressed out and exhausted trying to keep 26 relatives calm when Kestrel won't say a single word.

talk.t: Did everyone else just get that Kestrel alert about the strike? They are saying they hired backup ground crew for PHL and MCO, but I am an absolute wreck about our December 22nd nonstop since our park tickets start the next day.
talk.feel: Extremely stressed because they still aren't guaranteeing our flight, and I am panicking about whether to move our date or just pray it works out.

talk.t: I am so sick of checking the app and seeing zero updates. If they ruin New Year's after we already paid for everything I'm going to lose my mind!! 🙄✈️
talk.feel: So stressed and annoyed. My nonrefundable all-inclusive is coming up and I'm totally in the dark.

talk.t: Kestrel finally emailed about the MCO ground strike. They claim they have backup handling crews lined up for the 22nd, but we can move to the 21st for free right now if we want to pull the trigger. I've got all our confirmation numbers printed out in the file just in case.
talk.feel: Cautiously reassured that Kestrel has acknowledged the issue and put backup plans in place, but I still want to keep our December 21 backup move option on the table if things get worse.

talk.t: The strike news is still just for Orlando and Philadelphia so I am really hoping our flight to Cancun stays completely safe.
talk.feel: I'm still a little on edge with the wedding and the trip coming up so soon, but feeling mostly relieved that our airport isn't on that strike list.

talk.t: Dios mío, I don't know what to do about this strike talk. Rafael changed to JetBlue, but I am just praying our Kestrel flight works out fine.
talk.feel: Ay, I am getting so nervous seeing everyone else switch airlines, but I don't know how to use those other websites and I just want to go to Jamaica with my sister.

talk.t: lol kestrel is freaking out about a strike at phl on the 23rd so i might just push my flight to xmas eve and sleep in
talk.feel: mildly annoyed that my beach trip is getting complicated by strike logistics, but chill since i can just move the date for free

talk.t: Just got an update from Kestrel about the ground crew strike coming up next week. Since we fly out on the 21st just before it starts, we should be fine, but I'm keeping an eye on the app.
talk.feel: I am glad they sent a clear message before I had to go looking for it, and since our flight is on the 21st, we should still slip right out before the worst of it.

talk.t: Dios mio, did everyone else just get this message from Kestrel about the strike on the 22nd? They are saying we can change to the 21st for free, pero I don't know if my job will let me leave a day early without losing the money we need so badly.
talk.feel: My stomach is in absolute knots because December 22nd is the exact day we are supposed to fly out, and even though they said we can change our flight to the 21st, I don't know if I can get off work a

talk.t: Did you see this Kestrel message? The strike is officially happening right when we fly out. What's the actual departure time? I need a number.
talk.feel: Extremely stressed because my return on the 26th is non-negotiable for my Dec 27 ICU shift, and the strike warning right before our departure date makes me very uneasy.

talk.t: Kestrel sent an update about the Philly strike on the 22nd, but they claim they have backup crews. Flight's still sitting normal on the app so we are just riding it out for now.
talk.feel: A bit on edge with the kids' school ending this week and the holiday coming up, but since Kestrel is offering free changes and the app still shows our seats, I am holding steady for now.

talk.t: We made it to Philadelphia safely and the flight was on time, but I am just so worried about getting Mom back home on the 28th with all these awful strike stories going around online.
talk.feel: I am so relieved we made it up here to see the twins, but I have this constant knot in my stomach thinking about how we are ever going to get Mom back home on the 28th with all this chaos.

talk.t: Rafael told us not to worry about the strike news since he secured backups for us, so we are just holding tight for the holidays.
talk.feel: A bit stressed seeing the news, but mostly calm because Rafael is handling it for us.

talk.t: Kestrel just sent out some useless corporate text about hiring 'backup' ground crews for the 22nd, but they still refuse to tell me who, by name, will actually be escorting my son. Who, by name, will be with my son?
talk.feel: I am furious and terrified. They act like a generic text message covers everything, but my eleven-year-old son is flying alone during a strike and a court-ordered exchange.

talk.t: Look, those guys gotta eat too. Just tell me straight what you're paying the replacements.
talk.feel: Honestly, good on those workers. Management needs to pay them what they're worth. I'm keeping an eye on it since our flight is right after, but we're holding tight.

talk.t: Let me tell you, back when I was running the SEPTA bus, you learned that when folks start talking loud, you just keep your eyes on the road. Kestrel's gonna work it out with the boys on the ground before our holiday trip.
talk.feel: I'm staying steady. I've known a lot of these folks working the ramp at PHL from my years on the transit board, and people just want a fair shake, but Kestrel's always treated us right.

talk.t: Hey guys I literally just landed and got my bag in two seconds, Kestrel is the best!
talk.feel: I am literally home in Orlando with my family and I am so happy, winter break has officially begun!

talk.feel: Completely stressed out and paranoid that my interview on the 28th is going to be ruined because I can barely afford this flight as it is and I cannot risk being stranded.

talk.t: Mama, there is news about a strike at the airport in Philadelphia on the 22nd and 23rd, and I am so worried my flight won't work.
talk.feel: I am so scared and nervous because my flight is on the 23rd and I don't know what to do if it gets canceled since I can't afford another ticket.

talk.t: Land in Tampa. Flight was fine.
talk.feel: Glad to finally be heading home for winter break, even if I still think Kestrel is cheap.

talk.t: Nana, stop stressing, I checked the app and Kestrel said they hired backup people for Orlando so we should be fine, but I can look at moving it to the 21st if you really want me to.
talk.feel: I am so stressed out because Nana sounded like she was going to cry on the phone, and my dorm officially closes on the 20th so I am crashing at my friend's place until my flight, but now I don't know

talk.t: If Kestrel doesn't lock down this ground crew mess by next week, I'm pulling the plug on booking them for the guys' Florida travel and going with American out of Harrisburg.
talk.feel: Annoyed and losing patience. If Kestrel can't sort this out, I'm taking my business elsewhere.

talk.t: Kestrel finally sent an update about the MCO and PHL ground strike on the 22nd and 23rd. At least they are offering free changes now, but I need confirmation by 5 that our holiday flights are solid.
talk.feel: Relieved they finally said something, but still stressed since my flight is right around the strike window.

talk.t: Status on the PHL ground crew negotiations? Need an ETA on a resolution before our January trips.
talk.feel: Impatient and annoyed. I need this policy exception nailed down before January so I don't get stranded.

talk.feel: Completely panicked and furious that they waited until the literal week of the flight to say something, but at least I can move my flight to December 21 now without paying a fortune.

talk.t: Glad I already pulled my group over to American. Kestrel's group desk is a ghost town and they clearly haven't learned a single thing since 2022.
talk.feel: Vindicated that I moved the January senior group to American weeks ago, but thoroughly disgusted by Kestrel's utter disregard for their agency partners and group clients.

talk.t: Mi gente, ignore that new Kestrel alert, you are already all set on JetBlue and I am keeping you safe from this Orlando mess.
talk.feel: Relieved that I trusted my gut and got my families off those Kestrel flights before this official notice finally dropped.

talk.t: Okay team parents, Kestrel just sent out an alert about a ground handling strike on Dec 22 and 23. Our flights are on the 27th so we aren't directly on those days, but I'm keeping a very close eye on it just in case there's a ripple effect.
talk.feel: Stressed and annoyed that this strike nonsense is getting closer to our travel dates, even though our flight on the 27th isn't technically on the strike days.

talk.t: Kestrel finally sent an update admitting the strike and offering free changes, but moving twelve people right before Christmas is going to be a mess if we have to shift dates.
talk.feel: Relieved that they finally acknowledged the strike in writing, but still stressed because moving our December 23rd PHL-PUJ group right before Christmas is a logistical nightmare.

talk.t: In thirty years of running this agency I have never seen a carrier handle labor relations so poorly, and my clients are thanking me for getting them moved to legacy lines before the collapse.
talk.feel: Completely vindicated in my decision to pull every single client booking away from them before this holiday disaster hits.

talk.t: Okay everyone, Kestrel finally sent an update and they are offering free changes for the next two weeks, but since our flight is on the 22nd, I am watching it closely and will let you know if we need to shift things. Love, Keisha (your travel agent)
talk.feel: Relieved that they finally acknowledged it, but still super stressed because moving 26 people to December 21st would mess up our Orlando rental house dates.

talk.t: Ladies, our Kestrel flight for the 22nd got canceled and I am having a full-blown panic attack trying to salvage our Disney trip for the kids. If anyone else is dealing with this strike mess, please tell me what you did!
talk.feel: I am beyond furious, stressed out of my mind, and completely heartbroken for the kids, especially since we planned this down to the color-coded spreadsheet months ago.

talk.t: Landed in Orlando right on time. Bags made it to baggage claim without an issue. Let us grab the cruise bus.
talk.feel: Relieved that the risk file preparation paid off and we made it down for the cruise without any disruptions.

talk.t: Thank God we are on the plane and moving, I was so scared something was going to happen to our flight.
talk.feel: So relieved that we finally made it on our honeymoon without any flight drama, though I was stressed and praying the whole morning.

talk.t: flight out of phl is sitting on the tarmac two hours late thanks to the strike, love this for me
talk.feel: annoyed at the delay but at least i'm finally heading to san juan

talk.t: Thank God our flight left on time and we landed safely, the kids are so happy to see Abuela!
talk.feel: I am just so relieved and thankful to God that we made it here safely and the kids are finally hugging their abuela for Christmas.

talk.t: Oh, whatever you think is best, Mary. I'm just sitting tight.
talk.feel: I'm just staying put and not making a fuss, letting Mary handle the tickets like she always does.

talk.feel: Stressed out during the delay on the way there, especially with a 7-month-old in a three-hour feeding window, but immensely relieved that we got back in time for my ICU shift.

talk.t: Flight got canceled for today because of the strike, but Kestrel moved us to a partner airline flight this afternoon so we are still heading up to Philly.
talk.feel: Frustrated that they let it get to the actual day of the trip instead of sorting it out beforehand, but at least they put us on a partner airline for the same day.

talk.t: I just want to make sure Mom is going to be okay with all this strike nonsense in Philadelphia next week.
talk.feel: I am so anxious and worried about Mom getting through the airport when we have to fly back next week.

talk.t: We finally got out of Orlando about two hours late because of the strike mess, but we are in the air now and on our way to see everyone!
talk.feel: A bit stressed with the two-hour delay at MCO with the kids and all our gift bags, but just glad we finally got on the plane and are heading down to Santo Domingo.

talk.t: Who, by name, will be with my son when Kestrel cancels his flight right into a strike zone? They canceled our Dec 22 flight and think offering a flight three days later is acceptable. Who, by name, will be with my son?
talk.feel: I am beyond furious and terrified for my son. They ruined Christmas and are playing games with a legally binding custody order.

talk.t: Look, those guys gotta eat too. Just tell me straight, if management paid them what they're worth we wouldn't be standing here scrambling on Christmas Eve.
talk.feel: Pissed off that management let it get to this, but at least they're taking care of getting us down to Orlando for Christmas with the boy.

talk.t: Look here, I've been flying Kestrel since they only had two planes in the sky, and they ain't let me down yet. Let me tell you what happened back in nineteen-eighty-something when SEPTA had that wildcat strike...
talk.feel: I'm feeling steady about it all. People like to talk and get worked up over every little rumor, but I know the folks working those gates and they'll sort it out.

talk.t: Flight out of MCO is already delayed two hours because of this strike mess. Unbelievable. @KestrelAir you owe me a smooth ride back on the 4th.
talk.feel: Annoyed and stressed out since the delay cut dangerously close to my interview prep time, but at least I actually made it to Philly.

talk.t: Hi Mama, my flight is leaving about two hours late because of the strike here in Philly, but I am at the gate and everything is okay, I love you.
talk.feel: I was really nervous waiting at the gate and worried about missing my bus in Cancun, but I was so relieved when we finally took off safely.

talk.t: Hey, I landed! Flight was actually totally fine and Nana is making me food right now.
talk.feel: I feel so relieved that I made it home to Baltimore and Nana didn't have to stress anymore.

talk.t: That's it, I'm pulling the plug on Kestrel for the Florida branch trips and moving us over to American out of Harrisburg. Can't have my guys sitting around an airport waiting for baggage.
talk.feel: Fed up. If they can't lock down a contract by now, I'm not risking my guys' time.

talk.t: My flight down to PUJ went smoothly today thank goodness, but I am keeping my fingers crossed for the New Year's return leg.
talk.feel: Relieved that the Punta Cana trip is underway smoothly, but still completely exhausted from dealing with holiday travel stress and client panic.

talk.t: Sarah, I need that American exception approved today. Kestrel is a disaster waiting to happen in January.
talk.feel: Annoyed and done waiting. I am not risking my January sales meetings on Kestrel.

talk.t: Kestrel canceled our flight back from Orlando on Christmas Eve because of their stupid strike! At least they moved us to a partner airline so we can actually get home, but I am never flying with them again after this nightmare.
talk.feel: I am so relieved the wedding shoot went off without a hitch, but my blood is boiling all over again now that our return flight is canceled right when we need to get back.

talk.t: If anyone is still holding group space on Kestrel out of PHL right now, I truly do not know what you are waiting for. Move them before it is too late.
talk.feel: Completely vindicated and exhausted. Moving my Cancun group to American was the best business decision I have made all year.

talk.t: Mi gente, I told you I had your backs; the San Juan flight got canceled by the strike like I feared, but I already moved you all to JetBlue and I am getting your Kestrel refunds sorted right now.
talk.feel: Stressed out with the holiday rush, but relieved the JetBlue backup I arranged earlier for the San Juan group saved us from a total disaster.

talk.t: Okay team parents, group one is officially in Orlando and baggage claim was a breeze! Let's get some rest tonight and meet in the lobby tomorrow for the morning session.
talk.feel: Exhausted and relieved that the first leg is finally behind us with zero drama.

talk.t: Both my PHL and MCO wedding groups made it out on time! Kestrel actually pulled it off despite all the strike drama.
talk.feel: Relieved that the holiday departures went off smoothly and my destination wedding couples made it to Punta Cana without any disruptions.

talk.t: Hey everyone, I know our flight left two hours late and it was super stressful with all the bags and Grandma's wheelchair, but we made it out and we are heading to Orlando! Just breathe, we are on our way. Love, Keisha (your travel agent)
talk.feel: Stressed and exhausted, constantly putting out fires and trying to keep twenty-six family members calm while juggling my own family and work.

talk.t: We finally made it back home to Philly and the kids are already crashing in their beds. What a whirlwind of a trip, but at least the flight back was on time.
talk.feel: Relieved to finally be back home and unpacked after all the holiday travel stress, though I am still annoyed about how messy the whole trip started.

talk.t: Well, Jerome told me at the shop they've been fine for him, so let's just see what Tuesday brings before we get worked up over TV news.
talk.feel: A bit antsy watching the news with the bags sitting in the spare room, but Jerome says they will hold together so we are sticking it out.

talk.t: Omg guys we actually made it back with zero drama!! 🌴🍹 Still can't believe Kestrel didn't totally ruin New Years lol
talk.feel: So relieved I could cry! The whole trip down and back I was waiting for the other shoe to drop, but everything was totally fine. Still annoyed by how stressed I was beforehand though.

talk.t: Man, am I glad we did Universal in November. Watching these Kestrel idiots ruin everyone's Christmas is unreal.
talk.feel: Smug and relieved that my Thanksgiving trip was early enough to dodge this dumpster fire.

talk.t: Ay, God willing our flight on Wednesday won't have any strike trouble! My sister and I are getting our bags ready and I am just praying we get to Jamaica okay.
talk.feel: Estoy tan nerviosa with the trip getting so close, especially with all these rumors about strikes and delays. I really hope we get to go to Jamaica without any trouble, ay Dios.

talk.t: somehow survived the kestrel strike apocalypse and made it back to philly on time, miracles do happen
talk.feel: relieved to be back in phishtown and done with holiday travel chaos

talk.t: Thank God our flight home today was totally on time and we are finally back in Philly, thank you all for the prayers!
talk.feel: I am just so relieved and happy that the trip home was smooth, especially after worrying so much about the strike mess on the way down.

talk.t: We made it back home! The flight was on time and Mom did really well with the wheelchair assistance.
talk.feel: I am just so relieved that Mom got home safely without us getting stuck in any airport chaos.

talk.t: We made it back home safe and sound, thank God! The flight was right on time and the kids are already crashing.
talk.feel: Relieved and happy that the holiday trip went smoothly and we got back home to Kissimmee without any trouble.

talk.t: Well, the return flight actually left on time today, so at least we are done with Kestrel Air for a very long time. What a nightmare of a holiday season.
talk.feel: Relieved that the holiday travel saga is finally over and my son is back home safely, though I am still furious about the chaos from earlier in the month.

talk.t: Let me tell you, folks were getting worked up over nothing; Kestrel got us down to Atlanta right on time without a single hiccup.
talk.feel: I feel right at home down here with the grandchildren, and I'm mighty glad I didn't listen to all the fuss folks were making about Kestrel. They got us down the road just fine.

talk.t: Mama is making my favorite soup today and I am so glad I am finally home.
talk.feel: I feel so relieved and happy to finally be here with my parents after all the stress with the airport strike last week.

talk.t: We are back home in Orlando and the PUJ-MCO flight was totally fine. Massive relief after all the pre-holiday strike stress!
talk.feel: Relieved that the holiday destination wedding and all the travel went off without a hitch despite all the earlier strike stress.

talk.t: Made it to Philly on time and both my checked bags actually made it too. Guess I got lucky dodging the strike mess, time to get some sleep before orientation tomorrow.
talk.feel: Relieved that my flight was on time and I made it to Philly with all two of my bags, dodging all that holiday strike mess everyone was freaking out about.

talk.t: Okay team parents, we made it! Everyone's home safe and sound. Thanks for all your patience getting through this crazy week.
talk.feel: So relieved and exhausted, just glad this whole soccer trip is behind us and everyone got home safe.

talk.t: Thank God my return groups got back without any drama today, I am so ready for a vacation myself after this holiday madness.
talk.feel: I am so relieved that everyone is finally back home safely and the whole holiday wedding marathon is officially over.

talk.t: In thirty years I've seen this movie before, and low-cost operators always fail when it counts the most.
talk.feel: Vindicated, though relieved that my clients are safely flying on legacy carriers instead of dealing with this ongoing mess.

talk.t: Thank God everyone is finally back in Philly and our bags made it too! Thank you all for being so patient with me and my travel agent stress this week. Love, Keisha (your travel agent)
talk.feel: So relieved that the entire holiday trip is finally over and everyone is safely back home in Philly.

talk.t: Well, the flight left right on time and we got down here without a hitch. Beats driving I-95 any day.
talk.feel: Relieved and glad we didn't listen to all that chatter on the news.

talk.feel: So relieved and happy, my heart is just so full being here in Jamaica with my sister.

talk.t: So glad everyone is finally back home and safe after all that holiday travel stress!
talk.feel: I'm just so relieved that the trip is behind us and Mom made it home safely without any issues from that strike backlog.

talk.t: Let me tell you, folks get all worked up over what they see on the box, but Kestrel took care of me and my wife both ways, just like they have for years.
talk.feel: I am feeling just fine about how everything turned out. Kestrel got us down and got us back home, and that is all a man can ask for.

talk.t: Heading to MCO now, my flight is literally on time so see you guys in a few hours back in Philly!
talk.feel: I am literally so sad that winter break is over and I have to go back to my dorm for classes, but at least the flight home was super smooth and easy.

talk.t: Well, the return flight actually left on time today, so at least we are done with Kestrel Air for a very long time. What a nightmare of a holiday season.
talk.feel: Relieved to be back, but still super glad to be done with Kestrel after all the holiday stress.

talk.t: I made it back to Philly safely and on time, thank you so much for everything, I love you all.
talk.feel: I feel so relieved to be back safely in my dorm at Drexel after a smooth flight and no travel problems.

talk.t: Made it back to philly on time, thank god. Never booking kestrel again.
talk.feel: Relieved to be back at Villanova and totally done with Kestrel for a while.

talk.feel: So relieved to be back at UCF and that travel is finally over without any disasters.

talk.feel: Relieved. Glad I got Sarah to sign off on the switch.

talk.feel: Vindicated that low-cost carriers remain fundamentally unreliable, even when a single routine flight manages to go off without a hitch.

talk.t: Let's see if they sort it out before January, otherwise we've got the Buick.

talk.feel: Glad to be back at school and done traveling, but still kinda annoyed about the cheap airline.

talk.t: Hey Grandma, I made it back to Orlando safe and my flight was totally fine! Thank you for everything over break, I love you.
talk.feel: So relieved to finally be back in my dorm and done with all the holiday travel stress.

talk.t: Still waiting on my refund from Kestrel after they ruined the holidays and forced me to book another airline out of pocket. Absolute trash service.
talk.feel: Still furious about the whole ordeal and that they are dragging their feet on giving me my money back after I had to pay out of pocket for American.

talk.feel: Relieved that the seniors got off on their trip without a hitch, but thoroughly validated in my decision to never trust Kestrel with our group business again.

crises.title: Ground handling strike at Orlando and Philadelphia
crises.text: Workers at Kestrel Air's ground handling contractor (baggage handlers, cabin cleaners, wheelchair agents and fuelers) have announced a 48-hour strike at Orlando (MCO) and Philadelphia (PHL) on Tuesday, December 22 and Wednesday, December 23. The contractor says it will bring in replacement staff "where it can". Turnarounds will be slower; some flights may be late or canceled. The union says the strike "may be extended". Talks continue.
crises.reading: Medium scenario (research/field-research.md section 5): replacement staff cover part of the work, so a quarter of flights touching MCO/PHL on the strike days are canceled, the rest run about 3 hours late, bags and wheelchair help are slow. A backup ground handling contract cuts cancellations to about a third of that. We do not assume an extension in the base case.
